pages.text: $(italic)Automation/crafting investment. Best for Artificer. 100% command-driven via KubeJS.$()$(br2)$(warn)Engineering effects are KubeJS-dependent (Phase 2). Points will activate retroactively.$()$(br2)$(bold)Nodes:$() Crafting Speed (reduce auto-crafter time), Machine Efficiency (+% processing speed), RF Generation (+% output, up to +25%).$(br2)$(bold)Branches:$() Resource Doubling (+% extra ingot chance) or Blueprint Memory (reduced repair/enchant costs). $(bold)Capstone:$() Master Engineer - machines in 16-block radius +50% speed for 60s every 5 min.
